themes.description: Users consistently report that the app becomes slow, lags, or hangs—especially after updates—causing frustration during trading and chart viewing.
Multiple reviews mention crashes, bugs, and missing features that prevent smooth operation or cause errors during transactions.
Customers express dissatisfaction with brokerage costs, external taxes, and overall fee structure, feeling that charges are higher than competitors.
Users request additional capabilities such as note-taking, purchase price display, chart indicators, and UI customization options that are currently absent.
Several reviews highlight poor or delayed customer support, with users reporting unhelpful responses and long wait times for resolution.
